result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.68% (14.02% vs 13.35%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 57.6% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.86 vs 0.75) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 2.52% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.52).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-33.59% vs -33.70%).
Rolling return range spans 10.25% to 19.06% (8.81 pp spread) — consistency score 75.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
